fonts.headings: Playfair Display (Luxury/Trust), Cabinet Grotesk (Playful/Bento), Space Grotesk (Neon), Anton (Responder)
fonts.body: Inter or DM Sans for maximum legibility across all templates

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-none

layouts.spacing: Use generous tailwind spacing (py-24, gap-12). Maintain padding inside containers (p-6 to p-12).

hero_with_top_cta.description: Full-height or 85vh hero focusing on a prominent background image. Must include clear top CTAs.
hero_with_top_cta.classes: relative min-h-[85vh] flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden
structure: 2. absolute inset-0 z-10 bg-black/40 (Overlay - adjust opacity per template, never full solid)
3. relative z-20 container mx-auto px-4 flex flex-col items-center (or grid for split form layout)
4. CTA group: flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-4 mt-8 (Primary button must be large: h-14 px-8 text-lg rounded-full)

service_card_with_photo.description: Standard service card displaying a photo, title, and description. Image scales on hover.
service_card_with_photo.classes: group relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-card border shadow-sm transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-xl
structure: 2. img w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-700 group-hover:scale-105
3. div p-6 md:p-8 flex flex-col gap-3 (Content block)

service_card_bento_variant.description: Highly visual, bento-grid style cards where the photo is the background with an overlay.
service_card_bento_variant.container_classes: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 md:gap-6
service_card_bento_variant.item_classes: col-span-full md:col-span-4 group relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-neutral-950 text-white min-h-[320px] isolate
structure: 1. img absolute inset-0 -z-10 w-full h-full object-cover opacity-60 mix-blend-overlay transition-transform duration-700 group-hover:scale-110
2. div absolute inset-0 -z-10 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/90 via-black/30 to-transparent
3. div absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-full p-8 flex flex-col gap-3

service_accordion_variant.description: For the OnePage template. A text trigger that expands to reveal a 16:9 photo and description.
service_accordion_variant.classes: overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-card transition-all duration-300
structure: 1. Trigger: w-full flex justify-between items-center p-6 text-xl font-medium
3. Image inside content: aspect-video w-full rounded-lg object-cover

bottom_lead_form_section.description: The mandatory full-form section placed near the footer.
structure: 2. Glassmorphic or solid high-contrast card wrapper (p-8 md:p-12 rounded-3xl border shadow-2xl)
3. Form grid for inputs (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6)

Responder.feel: The Emergency/Hero. Fast, urgent, high contrast.
Responder.colors: Primary: Warning Yellow or Alert Red. Background: Slate/Navy. High contrast.
Responder.typography: Heavy, condensed sans-serif (e.g., Anton or Impact style) for headings. Uppercase labels.
Responder.photos: Action shots. Workers in motion. Service cards MUST prominently feature high-quality photos.
Responder.components: Sharp corners (rounded-none or rounded-sm). Thick 2px borders. Solid, bold buttons.

Bento.feel: Editorial Bento. Immersive, high-end, visual impact.
Bento.colors: Deep cinematic backgrounds (charcoal, midnight). Accent: Subtle metallic or brand color.
Bento.photos: MASSIVE background photos for the hero with gradient overlays. Services retain the bento-grid overlay style.
Bento.components: Glassmorphism. backdrop-blur-2xl, bg-white/5 (dark mode) or bg-white/70 (light mode). Delicate 1px borders.

Trust.feel: The Authority. Solid, classic, structured, highly reliable.
Trust.colors: Navy blue, Slate, Off-White, Forest Green. Low saturation.
Trust.typography: Classic Serif (Merriweather) for headings + clean geometric sans for body.
Trust.photos: Professional team photos, pristine finished projects.
Trust.components: Bento layout for services, but using SOLID flat backgrounds instead of images. Sharp shadows, solid borders. Top CTA is usually a side-by-side hero split with a visible compact form.

OnePage.colors: Monochromatic base with one vibrant accent color.
OnePage.photos: Photos hidden behind interactions to keep the page clean, revealed on scroll or click (Accordion Services).
OnePage.components: Sticky floating navigation. Accordion service list (reveals photo + text). Lenis smooth scrolling (conceptually).

Neon.feel: Cyberpunk Local. Modern, highly differentiated, glowing.
Neon.colors: Base: Deep Void Black (#0A0A0A). Accents: Cyan, Hot Pink, Lime Green.
Neon.typography: Technical mono or wide tech sans (Space Grotesk).
Neon.photos: High contrast, slightly desaturated, with neon color burn overlays or duotone effects.
Neon.components: Glowing drop-shadows (shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(brand)]). Tracing beam borders for cards. Dark mode strictly.

Playful.colors: High saturation: Bubblegum pink, Electric blue, Canary yellow. Base: Pure White or Pale Beige.
Playful.typography: Chunky, rounded, or highly expressive fonts. Massive typography.
Playful.photos: Cutout subjects (transparent PNG style) or oversized photos masked in organic shapes (arches, blobs).
Playful.components: Hard drop shadows (shadow-[8px_8px_0px_#000]). Thick black borders (border-4 border-black). Marquee scrolling text bands.

motion.approach: CSS-first IntersectionObserver for performance. Tasteful micro-interactions.

scroll_entrance.stagger_utilities: Use style={{ transitionDelay: '100ms' }} or tailwind delay-100, delay-200 based on child index.

motion.micro_interactions: Images must have group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-700. Buttons should have active:scale-95 transition-transform.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Make creative, distinctive frontends.
Do not use generic placeholder text or image URLs. Use the provided realistic URLs from the design guidelines.
Do not center-align app containers globally (.App { text-align: center; }). It disrupts reading flow.
Avoid universal transitions (transition: all) to prevent breaking transforms. Use specific transitions (transition-all, transition-colors).
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case and role-based (e.g., data-testid='hero-book-now-button').
Do not use complete transparent background in header or overlays. Always use a backdrop-blur or solid background for legibility.
Ensure contrast ratios meet APCA/WCAG standards, especially when placing text over images. Use gradients or shadows on text if necessary.
Apply generous spacing (2-3x standard). Cramped designs look cheap.
Implement the requested top CTA and bottom full-form pattern globally across all templates.
Apply the required visual differentiation for Bento, Neon, Playful, Trust, OnePage, and Responder EXACTLY as specified in art_direction.

accessibility.contrast: Always apply bg-black/40 (or equivalent) to hero images underneath text. Text on images MUST have a subtle text shadow.
accessibility.aria: Include aria-expanded for accordions and clear aria-labels for icon-only buttons.
